items.name: debug_log
items.summary: When debugging is enabled, log errors.

items.name: ConfigFinder
items.summary: A way to find a config file given a directory or Python file. Uses a lot of caching.

methods.name: checkpoint
methods.signature: fn checkpoint<R, E>(&self, result: Result<R, E>) -> Result<R, E>
methods.summary: If we have an error, print all the errors that the config finder has accumulated. This is used to ensure that config errors are still surfaced if we exit early.

methods.name: clear
methods.summary: Invalidate all data stored in the config.

methods.name: directory
methods.summary: Get the config file associated with a directory. If no config exists on disk, returns `None`.

methods.name: errors
methods.summary: Collect all the current errors that have been produced, and clear them.

methods.name: file
methods.summary: Get the config file associated with a (non-Python) file. If no config exists on disk, return `None`.

methods.name: new
methods.signature: fn new(load: Box<dyn Fn(&std::path::Path) -> (pyrefly_util::arc_id::ArcId<config::ConfigFile>, Vec<ConfigError>) + Send + Sync>, fallback: Box<dyn Fn(pyrefly_python::module_name::ModuleNameWithKind, &pyrefly_python::module_path::ModulePath) -> pyrefly_util::arc_id::ArcId<config::ConfigFile> + Send + Sync>, clear_extra_caches: Box<dyn Fn() + Send + Sync>) -> Self
methods.summary: Create a new ConfigFinder a way to load a config file, and a default if that errors or there is no file.

methods.name: new_constant
methods.summary: Create a new ConfigFinder that always returns the same constant.

methods.name: new_custom
methods.signature: fn new_custom(before: Box<dyn Fn(pyrefly_python::module_name::ModuleName, &pyrefly_python::module_path::ModulePath) -> anyhow::Result<Option<pyrefly_util::arc_id::ArcId<config::ConfigFile>>> + Send + Sync>, load: Box<dyn Fn(&std::path::Path) -> (pyrefly_util::arc_id::ArcId<config::ConfigFile>, Vec<ConfigError>) + Send + Sync>, fallback: Box<dyn Fn(pyrefly_python::module_name::ModuleNameWithKind, &pyrefly_python::module_path::ModulePath) -> pyrefly_util::arc_id::ArcId<config::ConfigFile> + Send + Sync>, clear_extra_caches: Box<dyn Fn() + Send + Sync>) -> Self
methods.summary: Create a new ConfigFinder, but with a custom way to produce a result from a Python file. If the `before` function fails to produce a config, then the other methods will be used. The `before` function is not cached in any way.

methods.name: print_errors
methods.summary: Print and clear all accumulated config errors.

methods.name: python_file
methods.signature: fn python_file(&self, name: ModuleNameWithKind, path: &ModulePath) -> ArcId<ConfigFile>
methods.summary: Get the config file given a Python file. If no config exists on disk, one will be constructed.
